description: This PHP file defines the Cart class within the Opencart e-commerce system. The class manages shopping cart operations such as adding, removing, updating products, calculating totals, taxes, weight, and checking stock, minimum quantities, shipping, and download availability. It interacts with database tables related to cart items, products, options, discounts, and subscriptions.

classes.name: Cart
classes.description: Represents a shopping cart that manages products, subscriptions, and related operations within the Opencart e-commerce platform.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves the list of products currently in the cart, including detailed information such as options, discounts, subscriptions, stock status, price calculations, and related data. Populates the internal data cache if not already cached.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a product, with optional options and subscription plan, to the cart. If the product already exists with the same options and plan, it increases the quantity.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a specific cart item identified by cart_id.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a cart item with given cart_id exists in the current cart data cache.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a cart item by cart_id from the database and internal cache.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart for the current session and customer.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Returns all products in the cart that are subscriptions.

methods.name: getWeight
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total weight of products in the cart, converting units as necessary.

methods.name: getSubTotal
methods.description: Calculates and returns the subtotal price of all products in the cart.

methods.name: getTaxes
methods.description: Calculates and returns applicable tax amounts for the products in the cart.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total price including taxes for the cart.

methods.name: countProducts
methods.description: Returns the total quantity of all products in the cart.

methods.name: hasProducts
methods.description: Checks if there are any products in the cart.

methods.name: hasSubscription
methods.description: Checks if the cart contains any subscription products.

methods.name: hasStock
methods.description: Verifies if all products in the cart are in stock.

methods.name: hasMinimum
methods.description: Checks if all products meet their minimum order quantity requirements.

methods.name: hasShipping
methods.description: Determines if any product in the cart requires shipping.

methods.name: hasDownload
methods.description: Determines if any product in the cart has downloadable content.
